title: Lists 2.0 is ready for everyone
blurb: Build lists with inline item and recipe search, undo your edits, and plan your shopping in Shop. Start a list on this device without signing in, or keep an online list synced with your account and friends. Rows keep their price-alert bell and mark-as-acquired check, items that cannot be sold say so, and the estimate can break its cost down by datacenter and world. One change to expect: the Build estimate now prices only the units you still need, so its total can be lower than the old estimate, which priced whole stacks. Shop still plans whole-stack trips.
